title: A Fresh History 📜
excerpt: A fresh update to Unfriend History with removal batches, faster removals, new icons, and more improvements.
body:
Unfriend History has been reworked with support for both individual friends and complete removal batches. You can now view a whole batch of friends you removed and give each batch its own name.

Friend selection in Compact Viewer has also been improved. You can now click a friend's headshot to select them.

Removal is now faster and more consistent. Random stops, random jitter, and unrelated humanization pauses have been removed, while Removal Speed now represents the actual delay between removals.

We've also added new custom icons, a special background for pinned users, a gold Pin button, and several other visual improvements.

The Roblox Admin and Roblox Plus badges have also been redesigned, while the Star Creator badge has been removed from user badges.

A number of older systems have been removed or cleaned up, including the old self-repair utility, Rocpathca from the popup, the Backspace removal shortcut, the Pin button cooldown, and the old bot detection system.

We've also fixed Automatic Remove Banned Users, theme reverting to blue, the authentication modal appearing twice, pinned users exceeding the Plus limit, and several other issues.

And that's just some of what's new in A Fresh History.

added.moreInfo: Unfriend History now supports viewing individual removed friends or entire removal batches. Removal batches can also be named.
Added new custom icons, including a custom Pin icon and Trash icon.
Added a special background for pinned users.
You can now set your own polling time for background removals. Friends Remover Plus users get access to a shorter delay option.
Redesigned the Roblox Admin and Roblox Plus badges with a fresh new look.

removed.moreInfo: Removed the random ±20% variation during removals.
Removed unrelated random pauses during removal.
Removed Backspace as a Compact Viewer removal shortcut.
Removed the old bot detection system.
Removed the Star Creator badge from user badges.

fixed.moreInfo: Fixed Automatic Remove Banned Users so it works again.
Fixed the Settings popup reverting to blue instead of displaying the selected theme.
Fixed Full Avatar mode not including the selected background.
Fixed pinned users remaining above the allowed limit after losing Friends Remover Plus.
Fixed the authentication modal appearing twice.
Fixed selecting friends causing them to be removed automatically.

improved.moreInfo: Click a friend's headshot to select them directly.
Removal Speed now represents the actual delay between removals: Very Slow is 10 seconds, Slow is 7 seconds, Normal is 3 seconds, Fast is 2 seconds, and Ultra Quick is 50 milliseconds.
Reconstructed parts of the menu and moved older menu buttons into the header.
Loading now blocks buttons, inputs, and other interactive controls until loading finishes.
Automatic removal changes are now staged until Save All Settings is clicked.
Unfriend, Mutual, Block, and Unfriend transitions are now serialized so rapid clicks cannot apply stale states.
Clicking a status now provides clearer feedback, such as showing that a friend is currently online.
Replaced toast emojis with consistent inline SVG icons.
Toasts now remain visible for one additional second all toasts.
Name badges now appear in the Unfriend History.
It’s about time the Pin button was gold.
Unfriend Mode and Block Mode now load the correct GitHub-hosted logo.
